explanation: The order_id column changed from a bare integer (1000-1199) to a prefixed string ("ORD-2000"-"ORD-2199"). This converts the primary key from numeric to non-numeric text, which breaks joins against historical integer keys (zero matches), breaks integer casts (errors/nulls), and breaks dedup/PK-uniqueness and sequence-gap checks. All other columns (order_date ISO format, status enum, quantity, unit_price, amount with its gross quantity*unit_price relationship, discount_pct domain, email blanks, customer_id format, and the header/column order) are unchanged. The ID number range shifting from 1000s to 2000s is just normal new-day data, not drift; the format prefix is the corrupting change.
